description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a retail liquor store operated by Otter Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative with locations across the Fraser Valley and Interior BC. Located on 248 Street in the Aldergrove/Langley area, it is a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through this agricultural corridor. The store carries beer, wine, and spirits for takeaway purchase.
